newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP to sell plant for A$57 mln.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP to sell plant for A$57 mln.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd (BHP) said on Thursday it would sell its Newcastle-based Electrolytic Managanese Dioxide Plant to Delta Industries Electrical Industries Ltd for A$57 million.
BHP said it expected to take a A$49 million writedown on conclusion of the sale.
BHP said the plant produces about 23,000 tonnes of high quality electrolytic manganese dioxide annually for export to alkaline dry cell battery producers.

It said the decision to sell the plant followed a portfolio review by BHP. Divestment of the business would allow BHP's manganese business to be more tightly focussed on its core mining and smelting activities.
The group said it would continue to supply manganese ore to the plant under a long-term contract.
